reasons: Summary accurately reflects source definition of adjacency matrix as square matrix with 0/1 entries indicating vertex adjacency
Mechanism 'Connection Encoding' correctly describes binary entries, symmetry for undirected graphs, and row/column interpretation for directed graphs per source
